title: 25 Money Lessons Rich Parents Teach Their Kids
description:
Most of us learned about money the hard way. In many wealthy families, kids learn it at the kitchen table, years before their first paycheck. In this video I go through 25 money lessons rich parents teach their kids, from three angles: the basic math of money, the attitudes that get passed down, and the practical playbook, from a teen Roth IRA to spotting scams. They work for adults too.

Get The Ryan Rover Money Playbook: [LINK HERE]

Sources:
- Whitebread and Bingham, University of Cambridge, Habit Formation and Learning in Young Children (Money Advice Service, 2013)
- T. Rowe Price, Parents, Kids & Money Survey

- IRS, Roth IRA eligibility (earned income) and contribution limits

- Morgan Housel, The Psychology of Money (2020); Dunn, Aknin and Norton, Spending Money on Others Promotes Happiness (Science, 2008)

- Growth example: monthly compounding at 7% average yearly return (illustration, not a promise)
